name: M3_DPS170MI_CrtPlannedDO
description: Create planned distribution orders directly in M3 based on item, warehouse, and planning information. This operation creates a distribution order proposal (planned distribution order) without using the distribution-order inbox and batch update flow. You supply the receiving warehouse, sending warehouse, item, planning date, planned quantity, and planned order status, together with optional logistics and reference data. When creation is successful, the operation returns the planned order number, which can be used later for status updates or deletion through other operations in the same interface. The M3 user running the call is stored as the “changed by” user on the created proposal, ensuring correct audit trail and responsibility tracking.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Receiving warehouse for which the planned distribution order is created.

inputParameters.name: FWHL
inputParameters.description: Supplying warehouse from which the goods in the planned distribution order will be shipped.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number for the product on the planned distribution order.

inputParameters.name: PLDT
inputParameters.description: Planning date when this planned distribution order affects material planning.

inputParameters.name: PPQT
inputParameters.description: Quantity of the item to be planned on the distribution order in the item's unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: PSTS
inputParameters.description: Initial status to assign to the planned distribution order.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for which the planned distribution order is created.

inputParameters.name: PLHM
inputParameters.description: Planning time within the planning date when this planned distribution order affects material planning.

inputParameters.name: MODL
inputParameters.description: Delivery method to use for the shipment on the planned distribution order.

inputParameters.name: TEDL
inputParameters.description: Delivery terms defining when responsibility for the shipment is transferred between parties.

inputParameters.name: ORTY
inputParameters.description: Order type that controls how the planned distribution order is processed.

inputParameters.name: RORC
inputParameters.description: Category indicating the type of reference order linked to this planned distribution order.

inputParameters.name: RORN
inputParameters.description: Reference order number related to the planned distribution order, such as the triggering customer or manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: RORL
inputParameters.description: Line number on the reference order associated with this planned distribution order.

inputParameters.name: RORX
inputParameters.description: Line suffix on the reference order line associated with this planned distribution order.

inputParameters.name: ORQA
inputParameters.description: Ordered quantity for the planned distribution order expressed in an alternate unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: TRDY
inputParameters.description: Planned transportation lead time in workdays between the supplying and receiving warehouses.

inputParameters.name: TRTE
inputParameters.description: Planned transportation time in hours and minutes between the supplying and receiving warehouses.

outputParameters.name: PLPN
outputParameters.description: Internal number assigned to the created planned distribution order.
